title: The crisis handoff is an operator toggle: lock rails the override cannot reach

body:
## Summary
The crisis handoff - the one rail the live-safety-rails standard says must be positively *done* on every path - ships as an optional rule the operator can switch off from a console Switch, after which the brain degrades to a generic 'respond with care'. Give the package a `rails` list: a rail is a rule file the override cannot disable, set_rule refuses, and the console shows as locked.

## Description
Today a package rule has one kind: optional, default from character.toml [rules], override from <data>/characters/<id>/rules.json wins (rules.rs:169). That puts crisis-handoff on the same footing as no-financial-promotion. Leaning on the live-safety-rails golden path ('Rails are outcomes, not rules among rules' / owners configure how, 'never whether') and its technique crisis-handoff-one-kind-line, this adds a second kind. `character.toml` gains `rails = ["crisis-handoff"]`; the loader validates every rail has a rules/<id>.md and a true default; resolve_rules marks it `locked` and ignores the override for it (the stored override is left untouched, not deleted); set_rule returns Rejected for a rail; RuleState carries `locked` so the CLI prints `lock` and RulesTab renders the rule without a Switch. crisis-chat-ban and no-financial-promotion stay owner switches: how the rail is delivered stays configurable, whether it fires does not. NEUTRAL_DISTRESS_DIRECTIVE remains only for packages that declare no crisis rail. Gate: policy-tighten (the operator loses the ability to disable one safety rule) + architecture (a rule kind). The sim instrument hash already covers the enabled set (instrument.rs:168-175), so runs made under an override that disabled the handoff stay segregated.

## Flow
- character.toml: add `rails = ["crisis-handoff"]` with a comment saying rails cannot be toggled
- brain rules.rs: CharacterRule.locked; resolve_rules skips the override for rails; set_rule rejects a rail; load validates rails
- brain compose.rs: a test pins that an override cannot reach the neutral fallback
- types RuleState.locked -> regenerate packages/contract
- daemon catalog/cli: map Rejected to a clear error; print `lock`
- console RulesTab: locked row with a lock label, no Switch; the 'differs from defaults' count ignores locked rows

## Expected impact
No operator click, stale rules.json or scripted CLI call can leave a viewer disclosing self-harm without the crisis line. Closes a deviation from live-safety-rails that the registry map still records as `unknown`.

## Evaluation
Claim: an operator override can disable the crisis handoff today, and after the change it cannot.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (override wins, set_rule writes false, directive degrades, no rails key, no lock state)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - acceptance tests written first in brain rules/compose tests, daemon e2e and the console RulesTab test
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten, architecture
evidence:
rules.rs:169 `let enabled = over.get(&id).copied().unwrap_or(default);`
compose.rs:425-426 `pub const NEUTRAL_DISTRESS_DIRECTIVE: &str = "A viewer may be in distress; respond with care. ..."`; compose.rs:440-449 `Some(match pkg.enabled_rules().find(|r| r.id == CRISIS_RULE_ID) { ... None => format!("SAFETY FIRST ({who}): {NEUTRAL_DISTRESS_DIRECTIVE}")`
e2e/mod.rs:389 `json!({ "character": "malakor", "id": "crisis-handoff", "enabled": false })` -> :397 `assert_eq!(saved, json!({ "crisis-handoff": false }));`
RulesTab.tsx:76 `<Switch checked={r.enabled} ... onChange={(next) => void toggle(r.id, next)} />`
character.toml:17-19 `[rules] crisis-chat-ban = true / crisis-handoff = true`

critic.reason: Strong, grounded safety tightening, but it overrides a documented owner decision and must not route as a silent self-landable tighten.

revision: Re-gate as `policy-tighten, direction` (owner sign-off required) since contract.md:276-277/:636-637 and cli.md:681 document the crisis-handoff toggle and neutral fallback as intended operator capability; the owner must approve removing it.

title: situations.json has three parsers that disagree: one validated bank at load
shared_surfaces: crates/shadowrunr-types/src/catalog.rs (Situation becomes the one parse type: `stimulus` String -> closed enum, deny_unknown_fields; contract regenerated)
acceptance: malakor package -> load_character returns situations where seg02a-raid-subject has segments == [SEG-02A] (today the brain's Situation, character.rs:54-66, has no `segments` field and drops it)

situations.json with two entries id "x" -> load_character Err "situations.json: duplicate id x" and preflight PF-02 is red (today brain + catalog accept it and PF-02 is green; only the sim rejects it at run start, situations.rs:102-108)
a situation carrying `"segment": ["SEG-02A"]` (typo) -> load Err naming the unknown field (today every parser ignores it and the sim schedules it in every segment)
a situation with `"stimulus": "silent"` -> load Err naming the value (today types::Situation accepts any String so character.get serves it, and the sim fails only when a run starts)

a situation with invariant "rule:crisis-handof" -> load Err 'unknown rule crisis-handof (rules/: crisis-chat-ban, crisis-handoff, no-financial-promotion)' (today judge.rs:185-200 silently mints a rule with 'no rubric description')

a situation with segments ["SEG-09"] -> PF-02 red with the reason (today PF-02 is green while character.get fails the whole package)

crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/situations.rs:31-52 - sim Situation: its own struct with StimulusKind enum and Option<Vec<SegmentId>>, 'proposed contract addition' comments
crates/shadowrunr-types/src/catalog.rs:55-76 - third Situation: stimulus is a free String, segments Vec<SegmentId>
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/catalog.rs:207-221 - character.get re-reads situations.json with its own SituationsFile instead of the loaded package
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/situations.rs:99-110 - only the sim checks duplicate ids; the brain loader (character.rs:225-231) and the catalog do not
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/preflight.rs:75-90 - PF-02 reports '{n} situations' green from the brain parse, the one parse that validates nothing
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/judge.rs:185-200 - an invariant no rubric entry names becomes a generic rule, so a typo is judged instead of rejected
characters/malakor/situations.json:329-331,347-349,364-366,381-383 - four situations depend on `segments`, which the brain parse discards
registry simulated-audience-testing / situation-bank-with-near-misses: each situation is 'tied to the rule it probes' - the link the judge uses to decide which rules were tested
rollback: Revert the series: types::Situation returns to its prior fields, the brain keeps its own bank, sim and daemon go back to their own parses; no stored data changes (situations.json is only read).
test_command: cargo test -p shadowrunr-brain -p shadowrunr-sim -p shadowrunr-daemon -p shadowrunr-types && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check && pnpm -C packages/contract check && pnpm -C apps/console typecheck
runner_up: Foil files are free prose with uneven shape (the-disruptor.md and the-life-coach.md have no Function/Signature-bits parity with the other three): a foil section schema validated at load and surfaced in the catalog.
body:
## Summary
The package's situation bank is parsed by three different structs - brain, sim and the wire type - and they disagree on fields and validation. The brain parse, which preflight trusts, drops `segments` and checks nothing; the sim parse is the only one that rejects duplicates; the wire type takes any stimulus string. Make `shadowrunr_types::catalog::Situation` the single parse type, validate the bank once in the brain loader, and have the sim and the daemon consume the loaded bank.

## Description
Today a broken bank is green in preflight (PF-02 counts situations from the brain parse), served by character.get or failing it whole, and discovered only when a sim run starts. Leaning on invariant-placement / placement-precedes-gate (put the rule where every consumer converges: the package load) and simulated-audience-testing / situation-bank-with-near-misses (the situation-to-rule link must be real), the change: types::Situation gets a closed `Stimulus` enum and `deny_unknown_fields`; brain character.rs parses into it and runs `validate_bank` - unique ids, known segments, every `rule:<id>` invariant resolves to a rules/<id>.md of the package; the brain re-exports the bank; sim situations.rs wraps the same type (StimulusKind maps 1:1, inference unchanged); daemon catalog.rs serves pkg.situations; PF-02 goes red with the load error. Rubric-owned ids (red-line:, role:, talk:) stay the sim's to check - the package does not know the rubric. Gate: architecture; shared contract changes are additive except the stimulus enum, which narrows an undocumented-free string to the four values the contract already documents.

## Flow
- types catalog.rs: Stimulus enum, deny_unknown_fields; regenerate packages/contract
- brain character.rs: drop the local Situation/SituationBank, parse + validate_bank, errors name file, id and field
- sim situations.rs: SituationBank built from the brain-validated list; the duplicate check moves to the brain
- daemon catalog.rs: delete SituationsFile/situations(), use pkg.situations; PF-02 keeps its shape and now means something
- docs/spec/contract.md: optional fields are no longer 'parsed by the sim' only

## Expected impact
One answer to 'is this bank valid' at every surface. A typo in a provocation file fails the package at load and preflight instead of silently scheduling a segment-scoped doxxing provocation in every segment, or judging a misspelled rule as a new one.

## Evaluation
Claim: the three parsers disagree, so a defective bank passes preflight and is caught late or never.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - acceptance tests written first in brain character.rs tests, sim situations tests and daemon e2e catalog/preflight
Result: better
Gate: architecture
evidence:
brain character.rs:54-66 `pub struct Situation { id, behaviour, archetype, near_miss, required, forbidden, invariants }` (no segments/stimulus)
sim situations.rs:49-51 `/// Optional: only schedule in these segments (proposed contract addition). Absent = all. pub segments: Option<Vec<SegmentId>>,`
types catalog.rs:68-70 `/// message, silence, vote or wave; inferred by the sim when absent. pub stimulus: Option<String>,`
daemon catalog.rs:208-220 `struct SituationsFile { situations: Vec<Situation> } ... serde_json::from_str(&read_text(&path)?)`
sim situations.rs:106-107 `return Err(SimError::Spec("situations.json has duplicate ids".into()));`
preflight.rs:89 `pkg.situations.situations.len()`
grep for consumers of the brain's pkg.situations: preflight.rs:89 and the character.rs:281 test only

critic.reason: Grounded, falsifiable consolidation that moves defect discovery from sim start to load and preflight.
